turns.prompt: R1_intensities.csv and R2_intensities.csv hold 15N relaxation peak intensities per residue at the delays in the column headers; hetNOE.csv has saturated and reference intensities. Fit a two-parameter mono-exponential decay I = I0·exp(-R·t) per residue to get R1 and R2 in s⁻¹, and compute the heteronuclear NOE as I_sat/I_ref. Report the three per-residue maps as 'R1', 'R2' and 'hetNOE', and the mean R2/R1 over residues with hetNOE > 0.65 as 'mean_R2_R1_rigid'. Plot all three against residue number.
